fixtureNotice: All names, companies, domains, phone numbers, songs, identifiers, and business activity in this file are fictional test data.
dateShift: Every timestamp in this file is anchored on demo.date. A seeder that runs on another day adds (seed date - demo.date) whole days to every ISO timestamp in workspace and control rows and to every Better Auth epoch-millisecond value; ids keep their values. EXPECTED.md then holds for the seed date. No follow-up time lies within two hours of a local midnight, so a DST change inside the shift does not move a cell across a day.

provisionerOwned.note: WorkspaceProvisioner writes these rows (CONTRACT §7.2). A seeder that provisions first keeps the provisioner's rows and maps the keys to them; validate.mjs loads them as given.

You said the harbor keeps what we hide
Ocean blue, ocean blue
I keep sailing back to you
